title: kith-peer: auto-create Contact on first inbound delivery
description:
What: KITH-nu1 is fully covered by KITH-efh step 10 (ContactStore::upsert called inside the Peer/deliver handler using caller.identity.node_name). No separate implementation needed.

This bead is a tracking placeholder. When KITH-efh is complete and its implementation includes the ContactStore::upsert call in the handler, close this bead as covered.

Algorithm: N/A — covered by KITH-efh.

Acceptance: KITH-efh passes its acceptance criteria AND cargo test -p kith-peer includes a test that verifies a new contact row is created on first Peer/deliver from an unknown peer.
